credit_line: Gift of The Georgia O'Keeffe Foundation
description: Portrait of three men, all wearing denim jeans, two in cowboy hats, leaning over portable tables with supplies for food preparation. Pots and pans in foreground, rock outcropping in background. This photograph is part of an album created by Ansel Adams after his 1938 trip to Yosemite with Georgia O'Keeffe, David McAlpin, and Helen and Godfrey Rockefeller. This is one of only three albums created for his travel companions documenting their trip.
title: Untitled (Robert Barnett, Alvin Rhode, Lile Pierce)
